inline.afterHeadingEn: ## How to Read Why Am I Still Single in Your Chart
inline.titleEn: Five Chart Signals to Read for Relationship Patterns
inline.altEn: Five astrological signals for reading singleness patterns: seventh house, Venus, Saturn, Moon, and current transits

items.subEn: Speaks to one-to-one partnership; a loaded or empty house both carry meaning, and its ruler hints at where your relating energy tends to go
Describes how you give and receive affection and where your attraction style may run hot or cautious
Points to slower timing and a need for security before letting someone in; reads as patience rather than permanent solitude
Shows what emotional safety looks like for you and what tends to make closeness feel safe or risky
Highlight seasons that lean toward reflection versus seasons that lean toward connection

inline.afterHeadingEn: ## Why Am I Still Single vs Why Am I Afraid of Commitment: What Actually Differs
inline.titleEn: Still Single vs. Afraid of Commitment: Two Different Lenses
inline.altEn: Comparison of the still-single outward lens on patterns and timing versus the commitment-fear inward lens on closeness and retreat

linesEn: Looks outward at patterns, timing, and circumstance
Focuses on who you've met, how your seasons have lined up, and what you value in a match
Gives a wider, gentler view of your whole relational history
Costs the comfort of blaming only luck or bad timing

columns.nameEn: Why Am I Afraid of Commitment
linesEn: Looks inward at what happens when closeness actually gets real
Focuses on the specific moment when exits start to feel tempting
Gives sharp focus on one particular moment of retreat
Can shrink a full life story down to a single flaw

inline.titleEn: Four Common Misreadings of Singleness in the Birth Chart
inline.altEn: Four common misreadings of birth chart singleness signals alongside what the chart actually shows

items.subEn: No one marker decides your relationship life; the chart describes leanings that interact, not a life sentence

items.nameEn: A hard Venus or Saturn aspect means unlovable
items.subEn: Challenging aspects often describe depth, caution, or slower timing; many people with them build lasting bonds

items.nameEn: The chart names the date you'll couple up
items.subEn: Astrology reflects tendencies and timing themes and cannot predict a guaranteed event or deadline

items.nameEn: Being single is a problem the chart must solve
items.subEn: The framing works best as a lens for self-awareness, not a fix-it tool that treats singleness as broken
